title: Fall 2021 Research Assistant Application
html: We encouraged applications for a Fall 2021 undergraduate research assistant position. The deadline was July 30, 2021 at 11:59 p.m. Questions were directed to dependlab@unc.edu. The original recruitment PDF is no longer available from the UNC server.

title: Fall 2022 RA Application Deadline
html: July 27, 2022 was the final day to apply for the Fall 2022 undergraduate research assistant position. Questions were directed to dependlab@unc.edu.
